purpose: Test a causally independent short-horizon mean-reversion entry source based on completed-bar RSI(2) exhaustion within a 200-bar trend context.
independence: Completed-bar RSI and SMA decisions only.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes MQL5 Article — Day Trading Larry Connors RSI2 Mean-Reversion Strategies
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Classic: RSI(2)<5 long only above SMA200; RSI(2)>95 short only below SMA200. Pullback variant: three consecutive RSI(2)<10 or >90 with the same SMA200 trend alignment.

public_logic_sources.source: MetaQuotes Code Base — Larry Conners RSI 2
public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: RSI(2) extreme plus slow MA200 trend filter; completed previous candle inputs.
public_logic_sources.role: Independent MetaQuotes code-base corroboration of RSI2 + MA200 grammar.

public_logic_sources.disclosed_logic: Treats mean reversion and structure-fade models as distinct gold model families.
public_logic_sources.role: Gold-specific community corroboration only; performance claims and undisclosed model details ignored.

indicator_semantics.rsi: Wilder-smoothed RSI on completed Bid closes, period 2
indicator_semantics.trend: simple moving average of 200 completed Bid closes
indicator_semantics.proposal_timing: first executable tick at or after the completed signal-bar right edge

R037-RSI2-C01_M1_CLASSIC_TREND200.trigger: RSI2 < 5 long with close > SMA200; RSI2 > 95 short with close < SMA200

R037-RSI2-C02_M1_PULLBACK3_TREND200.trigger: three consecutive RSI2 < 10 long with current close > SMA200; three consecutive RSI2 > 90 short with current close < SMA200

R037-RSI2-C03_M5_CLASSIC_TREND200.trigger: RSI2 < 5 long with close > SMA200; RSI2 > 95 short with close < SMA200

R037-RSI2-C04_M5_PULLBACK3_TREND200.trigger: three consecutive RSI2 < 10 long with current close > SMA200; three consecutive RSI2 > 90 short with current close < SMA200

execution.proposal_entry: first executable tick at/after completed signal bar edge
execution.candidate_rearm: one independent proposal per qualifying completed bar

screen_gate.winner_or_quality_gate: official-win delta nonnegative OR positive net with improved gross loss

selection: Only preregistered configs may survive; strong screen first, then screen pass, net delta, official-win delta, accepted entries.
forbidden: RSI period or threshold tuning after result
